subject: Renewal: consumption cushion, price-hold proposal, and commit mix
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Lin <susan.lin@evergreenretail.com>, Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@evergreenretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal: consumption cushion, price-hold request, and commit-mix

Hi Susan / Carlos,

Thanks again for the thoughtful conversation last week. Attached is a concise renewal proposal that aims to protect Evergreen during your holiday peak while giving you a clear path to scale (and sensible economics for both sides). High level:

- Term: 12 months starting 2027-07-01
- Commit mix: 60% committed, 40% pay-as-you-go (ability to true-up quarterly)
- Price-hold: provisional 90-day price hold on quoted unit rates, extendable to 6 months subject to signed commitment and PO timing
- Intro credit: $45k migration/onboarding credit applied to first two invoices (split: $25k upfront, $20k after go-live)
- Discounting: tiered effective discounts at commit thresholds; see attached pricing grid for exact bands
- Ops readiness: dedicated onboarding cadence + two weeks of prioritized support for model tuning

Attachments: Evergreen_MAP_v3.pdf (mutual action plan), redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx (numbers).

Can you confirm whether Procurement needs a formal PO by 2027-06-20 to secure the 90-day hold? If so we can switch to a short addendum and provide an invoice schedule that aligns with your AP.

If it helps, I can schedule a 30-minute call with Ben + Naomi to walk through the pricing grid later this week.

Best,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Susan Lin <susan.lin@evergreenretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@evergreenretail.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: consumption cushion, price-hold request, and commit-mix

Karthik,

Thanks for the proposal and the clear MAP. A few things from Procurement and Finance:

- PO timing: we need internal approvals and a PO by 2027-06-28 to meet our quarter close. Any price-hold should be tied to that PO or a signed amendment.
- Invoice cadence: Evergreen prefers net-45 invoices but we can be flexible if Redwood can split the first invoice to accommodate the $25k upfront credit and the remainder after go-live.
- Migration credit: appreciate the $45k credit. Can you clarify whether this is refundable if we reduce usage in Q1 (we need credit protection terms)?
- SLA & audit: procurement asked for a one-page addendum referencing uptime SLA and monthly usage reports.

We are aligned with the commit mix concept but need a short addendum (no more than 2 pages) that: (a) secures the price-hold conditional on PO, (b) defines the credit application schedule, and (c) clarifies invoice timing.

Can Ben or Naomi share a draft addendum later today? That will speed approvals.

Thanks,
Susan Lin
VP, Platform & Data, Evergreen Retail

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: consumption cushion, price-hold request, and commit-mix

Team — quick internal alignment notes to prep a response for Susan:

1) Price-hold mechanics
- Offer an initial 90-day price hold effective from sign date; extend to 180 days if PO received by 2027-06-28 (per Susan's timeline).

2) Credits & invoice flow
- Migration credit: non-refundable operational credit applied to invoice amounts; if usage drops below 50% of forecast in Q1, credit re-evaluated and prorated (protects Redwood).
- Invoice split: we can issue two line-item invoices for month 1: (a) onboarding charge net-45 less $25k credit, (b) platform commit invoiced on net-45 after go-live. Finance (Naomi) — please confirm we can accept the split without changing revenue recognition materially.

3) Addendum draft
- I will produce a concise 2-pg addendum covering price-hold conditional on PO, credit application schedule, and SLA references. Legal can handle redline limitations.

Ask: Naomi, can you confirm the accounting treatment by EOD so we don't slow procurement? Marissa, I'll loop you on the addendum once I have a draft.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Lin <susan.lin@evergreenretail.com>, Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@evergreenretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: consumption cushion, price-hold request, and commit-mix

Susan — attaching the short addendum and a 1-page pricing summary for easy review. Key points in the attached addendum (Evergreen_Addendum_v1):

- Price-hold: 90 days from sign, auto-extend to 180 days if PO received by 2027-06-28 and signed commitment hits the 60% committed threshold.
- Migration credit: $45k non-refundable operational credit; if actual usage in Q1 is <50% of mutually-agreed forecast, remaining credit balance will be prorated based on usage and returned as a credit hold for subsequent invoices.
- Invoice schedule: two invoices in month 1 to align with your AP team; subsequent invoices net-45.
- SLAs: reference to standard uptime SLA and monthly usage report delivery.

If this aligns, we can convert the addendum into an amendment and send a DocuSign link immediately. Proposed next step: sign addendum + receive PO by 2027-06-28.

Would you like a short call tomorrow at 10:00am PT for final clarifications?

Best,
Karthik

--
Attachments: Evergreen_Addendum_v1.pdf, redwood-pricing-summary.pdf

From: Carlos Mendoza <c.mendoza@evergreenretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Susan Lin <susan.lin@evergreenretail.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 15:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: consumption cushion, price-hold request, and commit-mix

Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear addendum.

We reviewed the language internally. Procurement signs off on the conditional price-hold and the invoice split. A couple small redlines from Legal (standard indemnity formatting and a definition tweak for "committed baseline"); otherwise we are good to receive a DocuSign envelope.

We will send the PO once Legal confirms redlines are acceptable. Please send the DocuSign link and the final amendment so we can queue for signatures.

Carlos
Head of Procurement, Evergreen Retail
